# Precompiled and asynchronous shader libraries

`HlslShaderLibrary` owns immutable FXC shader-linking DXBC used by `HlslEffect`.

## Generated bytecode

Package-generated libraries contain a reserved Kind/Profile/SourceCount metadata export. `CreateFromGeneratedByteArray` and the generated-file/URI loaders recover those values, then reflect the actual `PSBody` ABI and require the metadata to agree with it. External/legacy DXBC can still be loaded with an explicit `HlslShaderProfile`.

For samplers, generated source uses deterministic resource bindings:

```text
source i -> texture{i} at t{i}
         -> sampler{i} at s{i}
```

The build integration tests reflect real generated DXBC and validate these slots.

## Typed property ABI

Advanced typed effects support Scalar, Vector2/3/4, Matrix3x2, and Matrix4x4. The schema drives both the private native property metadata and `UserConstants : register(b0)` layout. Matrices use packed contiguous float backing constants plus generated HLSL reconstruction so the constant buffer matches the private updater's contiguous copy behavior.

`CreateCompiledAdvanced` validates the complete property schema against reflected `UserConstants` before creating an effect. Name, type/shape, offset, storage size, and final cbuffer size mismatches are rejected.

## Runtime compilation

`HlslCompiler` performs FXC work on a background thread and returns `HlslShaderLibrary`. It does not activate a `Compositor` or install the private runtime while compiling. Runtime-generated libraries use the same wrappers, metadata, typed-property declarations, and resource binding convention as the MSBuild compiler.

## Caching

`HlslShaderLibrary.Bytecode` can be persisted by the application. On reload, use a generated/self-describing loader for package/runtime-generated bytecode, or an explicit-profile loader for external bytecode. Reflection is a one-time defensive boundary, not a per-frame cost.

## Production guidance

Source known at build time should normally use `<HlslCompositionShader>` so FXC errors fail MSBuild and native C++ can embed `.g.h`. Runtime compilation is intended for dynamic/generated shader source and development scenarios.
